_: The tools the conductor can use, each with the mood it suits. A new tool is a new line here (and its code): the conductor finds it by mood, nothing else changes.

transitions.says: the camera goes through a thing (a lens, a screen, a planet) and the next place is on the other side
a fall into the picture until it fills the frame; the next place opens from the same point
a fast turn of the camera with motion blur: the next place arrives sideways
one place melts into the next: calm, a breath between two ideas
same place, the idea changes inside it

sound_beds.says: a deep low drone, almost nothing
soft moving air: clouds, a morning
a low rumble and a hiss, far traffic
a low machine hum with metal ticks
a high airy shimmer: an aurora, a wonder

actors.says: a phone, screen lit: the widget
a phone, screen off: the open microphone in the dark
